seo.meta_title: What Is Wildflower Bread Company? Arizona Bakery-Cafe Guide
seo.meta_description: Wildflower Bread Company is an Arizona bakery-cafe founded in Scottsdale in 1996, now just called Wildflower. Its history, how ordering works and what to try.

question: What Is Wildflower Bread Company?
quick_answer: Wildflower Bread Company is a locally owned Arizona bakery-cafe founded by Louis and Tracy Basile, who opened the first location in Scottsdale on November 1, 1996. In 2018 it dropped "Bread Company" and now goes by simply Wildflower. It's known for artisan bread baked fresh, breakfast with Lemon Ricotta pancakes, its Potato Cream Cheese soup, sandwiches and salads. You order at the counter and staff bring your food to the table. All locations are in Arizona.
key_facts: Arizona only, including two Sky Harbor airport spots

body.heading: Wildflower vs. Wildflower Bread Company
body.text: They're the same place. The chain opened as Wildflower Bread Company in 1996, and in 2018, as it opened new restaurants in Gilbert and Central Phoenix, it removed "Bread Company" from the name to go by just Wildflower. Its website is still wildflowerbread.com, and many locals still use the old name. It also isn't related to similarly named restaurants elsewhere, such as Wildflower Cafe in Mentone, Alabama.

body.heading: A short history
body.text: Louis and Tracy Basile founded the company and opened the first location in Scottsdale on November 1, 1996. The Potato Cream Cheese soup was on the menu from the start, breakfast and the Lemon Ricotta pancakes came in 1999, and seasonal favorites like the Turkey Cranberry Walnut Stuffing sandwich followed. In 2007 Wildflower opened a central production facility. Louis Basile is still the founder, president and CEO, and the company stays locally owned.

body.heading: How ordering works
body.text: Wildflower is fast casual with a bit of extra service. You order at the counter, grab a drink and take a number to your table, and staff bring your food, napkins and silverware. When you're done, they clear the table for you. To-go orders are called by name, and you can also order ahead in the Wildflower app.

body.heading: What to order
body.text: Bread is the core of the menu, baked fresh by hand, and the soups come with bread or in a sourdough bread bowl. Favorites include the Potato Cream Cheese soup, Lemon Ricotta pancakes, the Chopped Salad and the Cheddar Braised Beef sandwich, along with frittatas, toasts and seasonal sandwiches. There's also a bakery case of pastries and a pie of the month. Newer locations serve beer and wine. See our Wildflower menu for prices.

body.heading: Where to find it
body.text: Wildflower has locations around the Phoenix area, including Scottsdale, Phoenix, Gilbert and Peoria, plus spots in other Arizona cities such as Prescott and Flagstaff and two at Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport. Most locations open in the morning and close in the evening, and the Wild Rewards program earns points on orders.

faqs.q: Is Wildflower the same as Wildflower Bread Company?
faqs.a: Yes. Wildflower Bread Company shortened its name to Wildflower in 2018.
It's locally owned. Founder Louis Basile is the president and CEO, and he started it with Tracy Basile in 1996.
